design.primary_parent: v76 plus selected airport/t5/full-monthly refinements, production rounding
design.secondary_parent: v76 with production rounding; same method without any retuning
design.source: EUROCONTROL public taxi-out dashboard; local takeoff day and runway; minutes to seconds
design.train_selection: stand/runway present, true taxi in [0,7200]; only allowed outer training months
design.inference_selection: stand/runway present, incoming prediction in [0,7200]; no labels
design.calibration: airport intercept and airport count-deficit coefficient; equal cells; Huber20; ridge0.001
design.noise: per-airport training residual MAD times1.4826; floor10 seconds
design.prior_mean_variance: 200^2 / eligible cell count + 15^2; fixed existing daily prior scales
design.gain: prior mean variance / (prior mean variance + calibrated source noise variance)
design.correction: gain times source+composition minus predicted mean; raw gap capped at120 seconds
design.cap_provenance: same120-second raw cap as existing monthly stage; no cap/weight search
design.incomplete_training_days: require entire local day to lie in allowed UTC months
design.postprocessing: reapply matched/recovered plan bounds, then nonnegative nearest integer
design.limitations: Source cohort differs; true/predicted truncation differs; repeatedly reused Jan/Jul development
